name: Nahuelbuta: Piedra del Águila
why: Through a forest of old araucarias to a granite rock at 1,460 m that looks over Chile from the Pacific to the volcanoes of the Andes.
book: Park ticket at pasesparques.cl. Open Tuesday to Sunday 08:30-18:00, last entry 14:00. From Angol take the road to Vegas Blancas; no services inside the park.
water: Carry it: there is no reliable water on the loop.
dangers: Cold wind and fog on the rock, even in summer.
Snow in winter on the higher part of the loop.
The rock top has sheer drops: keep to the railing.
turnaround: The park's last entry is 14:00 and it closes at 18:00: be back at Pehuenco by 17:00.

points.name: Pehuenco
points.note: The park centre and campground among araucarias. A thousand-year-old araucaria stands a few minutes up the trail; then the path climbs west through araucaria and lenga.

points.name: Piedra del Águila
points.note: A granite rock at 1,460 m with a railing: the Pacific to the west, the Andes volcanoes to the east. Back by the southern path.
